_note: IP2025 cross-tool bridges and naming/export mappings. Source read-only: C:\Program Files\IP2025. Tier A/D facts only (mechanism + mapping tables); no algorithm code. Compare to Techlog's G (thin property-alias XMLs).

geolog_link.mechanism: Server-side Unix (Sun Solaris) link. IP (Windows) talks to a Paradigm/Geolog6 database on a Unix host via a CGI program executed through an Apache HTTP server (suEXEC module, runs CGI as the requesting DB user) OR via an SSH daemon (preferred: less admin, more secure; uses bundled PuTTY plink.exe/pscp.exe on the PC side).
geolog_link.binary: ow2odm (ow2odm -P lists Geolog/OpenWorks projects). Later package PGLWdblnk supersedes with owlnk/gllnk binaries.
geolog_link.requirements: Geolog6+ and a Geolog6 license required for the link to work. Historic stack: R2003 Solaris, Oracle 8.1.6, Forte Developer 6. IP read/write-to-DB only from Windows 2000/NT/XP-era client.
geolog_link.direction: bi-directional Read From / Write To DB (import Geolog wells/curves into IP, export IP results back).
geolog_link.relevance_sandibumi: Legacy/Unix-era, heavyweight (Apache/SSH/Oracle). NOT a model for SandiBumi's Geolog interop. The USABLE Geolog interop is the file-level ASCII/shading mappings below, which are the naming Rosetta stone.
geolog_link.tier: Tier D mechanism (infrastructure prose); no reusable data

openworks_link.mechanism: Same PGLWdblnk Solaris package serves BOTH the Landmark OpenWorks link (owlnk binary, owenv env) and the Geolog link (gllnk binary, glenv env). Transport = Apache HTTP+CGI (owlnk_import.cgi/owlnk_export.cgi, gllnk_import.cgi/gllnk_export.cgi) or SSH. Env vars: OWHOME, ORACLE_HOME/ORACLE_SID, LM_LICENSE_FILE (OW), PRDM_GEO_LICENSE_FILE (Geolog).
openworks_link.targets: Landmark OpenWorks (LGC), Paradigm Geolog6, and PGL's own IC databases. Introduced in IP v3.2.
openworks_link.relevance_sandibumi: out (Landmark OpenWorks not in Mahakam/SandiBumi scope). Documented for completeness.

geolog_ascii_import_options.purpose: Controls how Geolog ASCII exports are ingested into IP: which Geolog sets become Tops/Picks, and Geolog->IP set-name + depth-name normalisation.
geolog_ascii_import_options.relevance_sandibumi: v1-core. Directly reusable rules for a Geolog-ASCII importer: depth-mnemonic candidate list (DEPTH/TDEP/DEPT/MD/INDEX/TVD), tops-set recognition prefixes, and set-name aliasing. Small but a drop-in for import auto-detection.

geolog_shading_palette_mapping.purpose: Translate Geolog layout-file shading (named colors, fill styles, lithology codes) and color maps to IP equivalents on layout/template import.
geolog_shading_palette_mapping.relevance_sandibumi: later (presentation/template theming). Useful when porting Geolog layouts; lithology fill codes (CALC/DOL/ILL/PYR) confirm the mineral-fill vocabulary.

powerlog_bridge.purpose: Parser config translating PowerLog (CGG/Fugro-Robertson petrophysics package) script/equation syntax to IP's internal VB. A code-migration bridge, not a data bridge.
powerlog_bridge.relevance_sandibumi: out (PowerLog script migration niche). Noted for completeness.
powerlog_bridge.tier: Tier A (structure); do not port PowerLog algorithm expressions

loglan_to_vb_bridge.purpose: Parser/translation config mapping Geolog Loglan (.lls) operators & intrinsic functions to IP's VB target language: prefix/infix operators (** -> ^, |> -> Math.Max, |< -> Math.Min, / -> helperFunctions.Divide, 'to' range), used when importing/converting Geolog Loglan modules into IP user-programs.
loglan_to_vb_bridge.relevance_sandibumi: reference. Confirms the Loglan operator set (matches geolog-loglan skill). Not a data-model item; a language-migration map. SandiBumi reimplements methods from primary papers, not by transpiling Loglan.

dlis_import_mappings.purpose: Vendor-specific DLIS curve/axis/channel attribute -> IP internal name mappings, primarily for array/waveform (sonic, image) tools. Rows keyed by (Vendor, Type, AxisId, Property, IPName, FrameName, AttributeName).
dlis_import_mappings.relevance_sandibumi: v1-core-adjacent. Confirms the waveform-frame attribute vocabulary (sample rate/start/stop/Rx-Rx spacing) IP maps out of vendor DLIS. If SandiBumi ingests DLIS array/sonic frames, this is the per-vendor axis-attribute map to reproduce.

petrel_export_bridge.purpose: IP->Petrel unit-string normalisation on export/import (e.g. gm/cc -> g/cm3, usec/ft -> us/ft, ohmm -> ohm.m, api/gapi -> gAPI).
petrel_export_bridge.relevance_sandibumi: v1-core. Reusable unit-alias table for Petrel interop and general unit canonicalisation.

other_import_configs_noted.PetrologSets.xml: Maps Petrolog visual separators (*****, *EDIT_LOGS* etc) to IP set names on Petrolog import. Ships EMPTY (blank template row) in this install - concept only, no data. Tier A.
other_import_configs_noted.GeosteeringTypeLogSets.Xml: Default color-spectrum/scale presets for geosteering type logs (GR 0-150, GR_Rainbow default; spectra GR_EarthColors/GR_YellowBrown/GR_LithColor/Fracc_Spectrum/Poro_Spec). 1 default row. Scope: later. Tier A.
other_import_configs_noted.RequestedDataDescriptionLists.xml: WITSML/real-time streaming request lists (Explicit/Implicit; PTK Depth & PTK Time drilling-channel catalogs: HKLD/SPPA/ROP/RPM/ECD/vibration/MWD-LWD real-time codes). Scope: out (WITSML realtime). Tier A taxonomy.
other_import_configs_noted.SanitizingSchema.xsd: code/unit sanitizing map schema for illegal-mnemonic normalisation on import (see G_datamodel_schemas.json). Scope: v1-core concept.
other_import_configs_noted.IpClassicPythonlink.py: IP 'Classic' Python user-module bridge (IPLink class: SetupParameters/Run/UserCode, Read_Well_Attribute, per-zone input/output curve + parameter arrays). Analogue of Geolog Python-type Loglan. Scope: later (scripting).

naming_rosetta.note: Consolidated cross-tool entity naming for SandiBumi interop layer.
